name: Quadruped Wrist Stretch
steps: Kneel on all fours with your palms planted flat on the floor beneath your shoulders and fingers turned gently back toward your knees.
Keep both elbows completely straight and press your whole palms firmly into the floor.
Shift your hips smoothly backward toward your heels until you feel a clear, controlled stretch along the undersides of both forearms.
Hold calmly with steady breathing for the target duration, then shift forward gently to relieve pressure.
tips: Keep the heels of your palms flat on the floor and adjust your backward lean to control stretch intensity.
Turn your fingers outward to the sides if pointing straight back toward your knees feels too intense.
